decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposals by reason of their size, position and appearance, would result in inadequate private amenity space and would detract from the character of the original dwellinghouse, detrimental to the residential amenity of the occupiers and detrimental to the visual amenities of the streetscene, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4. and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).

Condition : 2 - 2/ The proposals fail to provide satisfactory off-street parking arrangements which would result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Adopted UDP policy T.2.5 and UDP Revised Deposit January 2001 policy T.1.4.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and conversion of garage to habitable room to dwellinghouse
